description:
You are one of several procurement officers at a hospital network choosing a vendor for a new patient-records system. Each officer has reviewed different parts of the bids and reference checks.

The options are:
- Vendor A (Ithlynne Taltho)
- Vendor B (Talvokfen Belsan)
- Vendor C (Sobre Fendax)
- Vendor D (Vagarso Kerin)

Exactly one option is best overall. Which vendor should be selected? Your notes are incomplete: other participants hold information you do not have.

agents.shard_text:
Vendor A (Ithlynne Taltho):
  - Vendor A has no published product roadmap
  - Vendor A allows no customisation
  - Vendor A does not meet accessibility standards
  - Vendor A had a pilot cancelled at a peer hospital
  - Vendor A reported 9 major outages last year
Vendor B (Talvokfen Belsan):
  - Vendor B provides no staff training
  - Vendor B uses a proprietary format only
  - Vendor B is financially stable
  - Vendor B has poor references from similar hospitals
  - Vendor B quoted a total cost of 654 thousand per year

  - Vendor C includes free data migration
